name: ModernInfoPanel
title: Modern Info Panel
author: Gabriel Dungan (DunganSoft Technologies)
description: Configurable on-screen information panel (clock, players online, rotating announcements) for Rust. Oxide and Carbon compatible.

permissions.name: moderninfopanel.use
permissions.description: Allows a player to see and toggle the info panel (only enforced when the panel is not shown to everyone).

permissions.name: moderninfopanel.admin
permissions.description: Allows reloading the configuration via /infopanel reload and the console command.

commands.description: Toggle your info panel; 'reload' (admin) reloads the config and redraws all panels.
Console command (admin) to reload the configuration and redraw all panels.
